index_supported_points.paraphrase: The official indexed description addresses collection of an unpaid cheque, bill of exchange or promissory note.
The indexed procedure describes a creditor holding an unpaid cheque, bill of exchange or promissory note as the applicant.
The indexed procedure distinguishes maturity of an instrument, bank dishonour of a cheque and a creditor's demand to a promissory-note debtor.
